payload.reason: The evidence describes a process involving multiple rounds of crowdsourced annotations, expert reviews, and automatic labeling of tweets related to job/employment.

claims.text: The type of annotation performed includes crowdsourced annotations and expert reviews of tweets.
Crowdsourced annotations involved multiple rounds (R1, R2, R4) to assess labeling quality and inter-annotator reliability.
Experts corrected tweets with divergent labels from crowdworkers, indicating a quality control mechanism in the annotation process.
